Management evaluated the Company’s liquidity requirements for one year after the issuance date of these financial statements, considering operating losses and operating cash outflows, outstanding liabilities, debt maturities, the subsequent dividend payment and acquisition-related cash commitments, together with available cash, net proceeds from the completed subsequent financing and expected customer collections.

The Company actively advances the remaining activities supporting capital formation and expects Financial Close and collection within twelve months of September 30, 2026, although timing also depends on investor participation and funding.

Based on its cash flow forecast, including the expected timing of collections relative to obligations as they become due, management concluded that the Company has sufficient liquidity to meet its obligations for one year after the issuance date of these financial statements and that substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern does not exist.
